runtime_state: Runtime conformance is not-run; validate the reference composition before use.

release.latest_release_tag_on_the_day_this_was_r: v5.36.0 (no newer release exists yet; `latest` is a build channel, not a version)

digests.what_that_value_is: the linux/amd64 image manifest of v5.36.0 (Content-Type application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json). compose.yaml therefore states `platform: linux/amd64`; an image pinned to one architecture and started on another is a pull failure with no diagnosis.
digests.what_the_index_digest_is: the OCI image index the `v5.36.0` tag resolves to (all architectures, Content-Type application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json). Use this value if you drop `platform:` and run another architecture; the `stable` tag carries the identical index and the identical amd64 digest, so `stable` and `v5.36.0` are the same content today.
digests.verified_by: sha256 of the manifest bytes returned by the registry, compared to the digest used to request them (self-hash), not to a tag page that asserted it

digest_provenance.method: Use the component contract and reviewed upstream pin; validate against your installation.
digest_provenance.resolved_with: python -B -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); from resolve_images import resolve; print(resolve('twinproduction/gatus:v5.36.0'))" -> {'source_index_digest': 'sha256:c5f210d0...', 'image': 'twinproduction/gatus@sha256:8df96411...', 'platform': 'linux/amd64'} on 2026-09-09; :stable returned the identical pair and :latest returned index sha256:c6ee1cc4... / amd64 sha256:09f5805b...
digest_provenance.tag_list_read: https://hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/twinproduction/gatus/tags, paginated to all 134 unique tag names on 2026-09-09: 131 of the form vX.Y.Z (newest by numeric compare, v5.36.0) plus three moving channels — experimental, latest, stable
digest_provenance.release_tag_vs_stable: v5.36.0 and stable carry the same linux/amd64 digest (sha256:8df96411...) and the same index digest on that date. Pinning the release tag's digest is still the point: `stable` is a channel that will move to the next release without asking.

superseded_digest.why_it_was_rejected: It could not be attributed to a release. Retained as an upstream pin audit trail; use the selected release digest for new installations.
superseded_digest.rollback: Setting LO_GATUS_IMAGE back to this digest is a supported, deliberate act with a reason, and it is a downgrade to content no release names. Record it in upgrade.md, not here.

mirror.why_it_still_exists: The catalogue seed now names this directory's versions.json:image. The old platform key is retained as a compatibility mirror, not as the authority. tests/test_catalog_registry.py asserts the seed's owning path and key because the old pointer still resolves. tests/test_gatus_component.py keeps the two image values equal. Removing the mirror and its guard is a separate change.
mirror.authority_rule: this file is authoritative for the Gatus pin; the platform key above is a mirror that no catalogue entry reads any more

depends_on.adapter: local_observe/platform/detection_worker.py (window, cursor, pending batch) over local_observe/platform/detections.py::gatus_sample (the envelope it refuses) and ::evaluate (the coverage rule)
depends_on.credential_delivery: local_observe/credentials.py::read_credential, which prefers LO_GATUS_TOKEN_FILE over any value
depends_on.rule_document: one availability rule per detector process, mounted from LO_DETECTION_RULE_DIR; its resource_id must resolve in the built inventory snapshot or evaluate() refuses the tick
depends_on.config_contract: components/control/synthetics/config.yaml, whose `security.basic.username` and bcrypt hash must agree with the base64 pair in LO_GATUS_TOKEN_FILE; CONTRACT.md states which of those was read at the pinned tag and which has never been sent to a running engine

credentials.mounted_files: Two, both read as `_FILE` paths by the detector: LO_GATUS_TOKEN_FILE (the engine's HTTP Basic pair, standard-alphabet base64 of `user:password`) and LO_PRODUCER_TOKEN_FILE, whose container path /run/secrets/detector-producer-token is unchanged. The environment carries paths and never values.
credentials.producer_token_is_its_own: LO_DETECTOR_PRODUCER_TOKEN_FILE supplies a dedicated producer credential. Its platform identity must equal the source in every mounted rule. A mismatched identity is refused with not_authorised and the pending batch is retained. See CONTRACT.md and examples/full/README.md.
credentials.unverified: Runtime authentication and delivery are not-run. Conformance checklist row 15 covers missing, mismatched and matching producer credentials.

platform: linux/amd64; the pin above is that architecture's manifest digest
distribution: upstream image pulled by digest; this repository builds nothing here, publishes no image and claims no signature
